description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'BaseAttributeTypeValidator' in the package 'org.openmrs.validator', which implements validation logic for AttributeType objects in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes validation for properties like name, minOccurs, maxOccurs, datatypeClassname, and datatypeConfig, along with handling for custom data types and handlers.

classes.name: BaseAttributeTypeValidator
classes.description: An abstract class providing validation logic for attribute types in OpenMRS, ensuring fields are correctly populated and consistent.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the given target AttributeType object, checking fields such as name, minOccurs, maxOccurs, datatypeClassname, datatypeConfig, and handler compatibility, recording errors as needed.
